SkipMissingAsinBookHelpText: Requires ASIN. Best for well-known, well-published authors where complete metadata is expected. Combined with 'Skip books missing identifier', requires both an ISBN and an ASIN.
SkipMissingDateAudiobook: Skip audiobooks with missing release date
SkipMissingDateAudiobookHelpText: Hides audiobooks with no release date in metadata. They will appear once providers add a date on the next author refresh.
SkipMissingDateBook: Skip books with missing release date
SkipMissingDateBookHelpText: Hides books with no release date in metadata. They will appear once providers add a date on the next author refresh.
SkipMissingIdentifierAudiobookHelpText: Filters out audiobooks without any identifier (ISBN or ASIN). Quick way to remove low-quality metadata entries. Combined with 'Skip audiobooks missing ASIN', requires both an ISBN and an ASIN.
SkipMissingIdentifierBookHelpText: Filters out books without any identifier (ISBN or ASIN). Quick way to remove low-quality metadata entries. Combined with 'Skip books missing ASIN', requires both an ISBN and an ASIN.
SkipMissingIdentifierOmnibusAudiobookHel: Removes omnibus/collection audiobooks only when no edition has an ASIN or ISBN.
SkipMissingIdentifierOmnibusBookHelpText: Removes omnibus/collection books only when no edition has an ASIN or ISBN.
SkipOmnibusAudiobookHelpText: Removes every omnibus/collection audiobook, even when identifiers are present.
SkipOmnibusBookHelpText: Removes every omnibus/collection book, even when identifiers are present.
SkipPartsAndSetsAudiobookHelpText: Excludes bundled collections like '1 of 3', 'Books 1-5', or titles containing multiple audiobooks separated by slashes.
SkipPartsAndSetsBookHelpText: Excludes bundled collections like '1 of 3', 'Books 1-5', or titles containing multiple books separated by slashes.
SkipRedownloadHelpText: Prevents Chaptarr from trying download alternative releases for the removed items
SkipSeriesSecondaryAudiobookHelpText: Only keeps audiobooks that are part of a primary series. Filters out spin-offs, companion novels, and tangential series entries.
SkipSeriesSecondaryBookHelpText: Only keeps books that are part of a primary series. Filters out spin-offs, companion novels, and tangential series entries.

SorryThatSeriesCannotBeFound: Sorry, that series cannot be found.

UseAsDefaultAudiobookRootFolderHelpText: Use this root folder when automatically adding audiobook authors and more than one audiobook or mixed root folder exists.
UseAsDefaultEbookRootFolderAutomaticHelp: This is your only root folder for ebooks, so Chaptarr will use it automatically for new ebook authors. Add another ebook or mixed root folder to choose a default.
UseAsDefaultEbookRootFolderHelpText: Use this root folder when automatically adding ebook authors and more than one ebook or mixed root folder exists.

UsePathAsTagsFallbackHelpText: If embedded tags do not match, retry using paths and filenames instead.
UsePathAsTagsFallbackStrictDisabledHelpT: Strict mode disables this retry. Path-based tags are not allowed to participate.
UseSslHelpText: Use SSL to connect to Calibre content server
WatchLibraryForChangesHelpText: Rescan automatically when files change in a root folder
WatchRootFoldersForFileChanges: Watch Root Folders for file changes

WriteAudioBookShelfMetadataJsonHelpText: When missing, store an AudioBookShelf-compatible metadata.json alongside book files in this root folder. This will NOT overwrite existing metadata.json files.
